title: T6-T7 segmental ROM inside C7-L1 specimen, with rib cage (Liebsch 2017)

quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: full-range segmental rotation (both directions) of the upper vs lower vertebra measured optically inside the polysegmental C7-L1 specimen at +/-2 Nm applied to C7; median with max/min of 6 specimens (negative = paradoxical motion)

source.authors: Liebsch C, Graf N, Appelt K, Wilke HJ
source.sample: 6 fresh-frozen human C7-L1 thoracic spines with entire rib cage (sternum, costal cartilage, ribs, intercostal muscles)

protocol.summary: C7 and L1 half-embedded in PMMA (screws in endplates; C7-T1 disc fixed with screws); L1 in angle flange at 20 deg (4 specimens) or 30 deg (2 hyperkyphotic). Pure moments +/-2 Nm at C7, FE/LB/AR, 1 deg/s (AR 0.5 deg/s), 3.5 cycles, last cycle; no preload. ROM of T1-T12 from optical markers on each vertebra.
how_to_simulate: Fix L1 (caudal) and leave C7-T1 rigid; apply pure moment +/-2 Nm to C7 in FE, LB, AR without preload
Model the rib cage structures present at this step (see ribcage.intact_structures)
Report T6-T7 relative rotation (full range) at peak moment while loading the whole C7-L1 specimen
protocol.notes: Monosegmental ROM within a polysegmental test; medians used by authors because of outliers (negative minima = inverse motion).

extraction.check_notes: Re-checked against rendered page 8 (Table 2 lower rows) and text layer.

pass_rule.rule: model within [min,max] of specimens (median as target)

ribcage.intact_structures: full rib cage: sternum, costal cartilage, ribs, intercostal muscles, costovertebral/costotransverse joints

loading.rate: 1.0 deg/s FE and LB, 0.5 deg/s AR
loading.cycles: 3.5 cycles per plane, last (3rd) cycle evaluated
loading.branch: maximum deflection at +/-2 Nm of last cycle
loading.device: custom spine tester, Vicon MX13 6 cameras (0.1 mm / 0.1 deg)

shared_sample_with: fe_resection_thoracic.liebsch2017esj.T1T12_ribcage_sternotomy_wired_rom_2Nm (same 6 specimens; ESJ intact/sternotomy rows = this paper's W/o IM and MST rows)
